cta.text: Request access and the platform team will set your school up: teachers, classes and your first paper.
cta.title: Bring PaperBuilder to your school

faq.a1: Fill in the request form with your school details. The platform reviews the request and, once approved, your school admin receives login details and a first-login checklist.
faq.a2: Yes. A paper can be built in Urdu, in English, or in both languages, and the preview switches between them before printing.
faq.a3: No. The answer key is a separate document. It is never printed on the same pages as the paper.
faq.a4: Your school admin reviews each submitted paper and approves it or sends it back with a comment. Schools can also switch approval off if they prefer.
faq.a5: Each plan sets how many teachers can use the platform and how many papers the school can build each month. Plans and prices are confirmed when your school is onboarded.
faq.a6: Yes. Request access and ask for a demo. The platform team will walk your school through a full paper, from setup to print.
